description: The principal carries the target's SID in its SIDHistory, inheriting the target's access.

telemetry.detail: SID History was added to an account - fires on injection, not on use.
Using inherited SIDHistory access is largely indistinguishable from legitimate access at auth time; injection is the detectable moment.

prerequisite_privilege: None to traverse - the SIDHistory already grants the access
abuse_primitive: Authenticate normally; the SIDHistory silently confers the target's group access.
notes: Quiet to traverse because it is a token-side inheritance. Injecting SIDHistory (4765/4766) is the loud event, and is a separate action from using it.
